requiredBehavior: Build a deterministic temporary plugin artifact containing the already-pinned model, WASM, licenses and manifest resources.
Verify exact resource hashes, byte sizes, licenses and package allowlists without changing resource bytes or the installed plugin.
Run the isolated offline install smoke using a temporary CODEX_HOME and prove the same Studio launch URL can be opened twice within the bounded window.
Keep all temporary artifacts and smoke state outside the repository and remove them after verification.
verification: pnpm --filter @routego-image/integration exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/install-smoke.test.ts

directSpecifications.reason: Temporary artifact, offline resource integrity and isolated install boundary.
Contained model/WASM resources and fail-closed integrity behavior.

reportingContract: Direct send_message_to_thread plus read_thread for every acceptance, activation, checkpoint, blocker, deviation and delivery; no final, heartbeat or polling continuation.
